title: implement make_rays_2d

atoms.evidence: rays = t.zeros((n_pixels, 2, 3), dtype=t.float32) — same preallocate-and-fill pattern as 0_1_0, now 2D-grid sized
rays[:, 1, 0] = 1; rays[:, 1, 1] = einops.repeat(...); rays[:, 1, 2] = einops.repeat(...) — three slice-assignments into the preallocated buffer
einops.repeat(ygrid, 'y -> (y z)', z=num_pixels_z) and the matching z one — outer product of y and z grids
the einops.repeat string 'y -> (y z)' uses the (y z) flatten/fold pattern; learner must understand the parenthesized-axis grammar to write it
rays are still O=(0,0,0) + uD; same as 0_1_0, geometry not the focus

notes: Direct generalization of 0_1_0 to 2D. The new content is the outer-product pattern via einops.repeat with the (y z) flatten grammar.
